name: gizza-ai/verify-checksum
summary: Verify that data matches an expected checksum (auto-detects the algorithm)

tool.description: Verify that a piece of data matches an expected checksum. Provide the input `text` and the `expected` checksum (hex or base64); the tool hashes the input and reports MATCH or MISMATCH along with the algorithm used. By default `algorithm`='auto' infers the hash from the expected digest's byte length; set it explicitly to check one algorithm. Set input_encoding='hex' or 'base64' to decode the input before hashing.
